label: Favouring determinations are realized on stand-in items
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every bearer b and every favouring determination of b (the real determination that a favouring of b is the profile phi), in every variation scenario s and for all candidates x, y, phi favours x over y at s exactly when a relation among items, indexed by b, phi and s, holds between b's stand-in for x and b's stand-in for y (the profile is the inverse image of an item relation under the stand-in assignment). Because the relation is indexed by the profile, several favourings of one bearer are allowed; one favouring per bearer is the separate open bridge 3e6ae3e7. A stand-in is the item through which a candidate figures in b's favouring. With irreflexivity, realization requires only that favoured pairs have distinct stand-ins. It does not require the stand-ins to be real in any further sense: the identity assignment (candidates as their own stand-ins) satisfies it, and such stand-ins fall under the own-favouring bridge 65805e5a, which carries the demand for real terms. The function shape of the stand-in assignment assumes that every way a candidate figures in a bearer's favourings goes through one item.
